description: This file contains the implementation of a Sybase database driver and associated recordset classes for the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library. It defines the class `ADODB_sybase` extending `ADOConnection` with methods for connection, transaction management, query execution, and metadata retrieval specific to Sybase databases. Additionally, it includes `ADORecordset_sybase` and `ADORecordSet_array_sybase` classes for handling query results and date parsing tailored to Sybase's date formats.

classes.name: ADODB_sybase
classes.description: Class representing the Sybase database driver, providing connection, transaction, and metadata functionalities tailored for Sybase databases.

classes.name: ADORecordset_sybase
classes.description: Class for handling record sets returned from Sybase queries, extending basic recordset with Sybase-specific date parsing.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array_sybase
classes.description: Class for handling array-based record sets and parsing Sybase date/time string formats into Unix timestamps.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted identity value for the current connection.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Locks rows in a table based on provided criteria.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message from the Sybase connection.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a Sybase database.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to a Sybase database.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query against the Sybase database.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a query with limit and offset support.

methods.name: UnixDate
methods.description: Converts a Sybase date string to a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: UnixTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts a Sybase date/time string to a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a given table.
